summary: MCA candidate with strong foundation in software development principles and methodologies, Java, and C++ — a proactive learner eager to contribute to software engineering.

projects.name: Concurrent FTP Server
projects.subtitle: Multi-Client File Transfer Protocol Server
projects.tech: C, POSIX Threads, TCP Sockets, Multithreading
bullets: Engineered concurrent client handling using POSIX threads over TCP sockets, supporting simultaneous file transfers without data corruption.
Implemented thread-safe resource management using mutex and semaphore primitives, eliminating race conditions under concurrent load.
Designed application-layer protocol over raw sockets handling authentication, file listing, upload, and download command sequences.

projects.name: Customised Virtual File System (CVFS)
projects.subtitle: In-Memory Linux-like File Manager
projects.tech: C, C++, Data Structures, OS Concepts
bullets: Simulated Linux file system operations (open, read, write, lseek) in C++ using inode-based metadata management and a custom shell interpreter.
Achieved O(1) file lookup by designing hash table-based inode indexing with chaining for collision resolution.
Implemented in-memory file allocation table using C++ classes managing file permissions, ownership, and hierarchical directory traversal.

projects.name: ProcMemInspector
projects.subtitle: Linux Process Memory Layout Analyzer
bullets: Developed a /proc filesystem parser in C to extract and display virtual memory layout of live Linux processes including stack, heap, data, BSS, and mapped library segments.
Implemented process statistics monitoring by reading /proc/[pid]/maps and /proc/[pid]/status with structured output formatting.
Analyzed virtual address space segmentation demonstrating memory isolation boundaries and shared library loading behavior.
